method: All annotations derive directly from unmodified authored 24bit WAV + authorSFZ. No detector imports, candidate outputs or note-driven threshold fitting. Activity bands are acoustic authored-sample cues, NOT physical pick/contact latency truth. Whole-file EOF is NOT a physical damping reference.

notes.core_scope: Nominal note should be represented continuously in this independently chosen early tonal body; no physical offset asserted. Pitch audit is descriptive and retains invalid/edge partials.
notes.offset_uncertainty: Author SFZ names staccato/ordinary, not per-recording damping times. Edited/faded file end and level-threshold crossing are not physical NoteOff truth. Do not score lateOff from EOF.
